text:
Olivia Park: Hi team — quick onboarding questions. 1) I started on 07/10 and enrolled in dental, but the portal says theres a 30-day waiting period. Can that be waived for pre-existing cleanings? 2) I submitted a moving expense reimbursement request last week and it still shows Pending. Any ETA? 3) I updated direct deposit but my bank says its not on file yet. Who should I ping?

Ava (People Ops): Welcome Olivia! Congrats on joining. Short answers: waiting periods are carrier rules (Sanya can advise on waivers), moving reimbursements run through payroll after People Ops approval (Liam can check the batch), and direct deposit pre-note usually takes 1-3 business days (Liam also).

Sanya (Benefits): Hi Olivia — carrier list: some dental carriers allow waiver if prior coverage had comparable benefits and you upload an EOB or coverage letter. Did you previously have dental with another employer?

Olivia Park: Yes, I had DeltaCare up until 07/09. I have an EOB PDF from my dentist showing last cleaning on 06/20. I uploaded it to BambooHR under "Benefits Docs" yesterday as "Park_Olivia_prev_dental_062024.pdf".

BenefitsBot: Document Park_Olivia_prev_dental_062024.pdf received and queued for verification. Position: 4.

Sanya (Benefits): Got it. If you can also add the carrier name and policy number in the doc note that helps. I can request a warranty waiver from the carrier; approval usually comes back in 3-7 business days. If approved, payroll will not charge the waiting-period premium or we'll refund retroactively.

Olivia Park: I added the carrier (DeltaCare) and policy number in BambooHR note. Thanks!

Liam (Payroll): On moving reimbursement: I see R-8890 approved by People Ops on 07/12 but the export missed the payroll cutoff for 07/15. I queued it for the next off-cycle on 07/19. Expect payment to post 07/20. It will be taxed as a taxable relocation reimbursement per policy.

Olivia Park: Thanks — is there any way to get an advance? I have a moving truck deposit due 07/18.

Liam (Payroll): We can issue a one-time advance; file an expense in the relocation portal marked "advance request" and tag me, or DM me and I can push an emergency off-cycle.

Olivia Park: Filed an advance request in the portal and tagged you.

Liam (Payroll): Got it, I'll push the emergency off-cycle so funds should be available by 07/18.

Olivia Park: Awesome, appreciate it. Quick direct deposit check: I updated routing/account on 07/11 and the payroll preview still shows old bank masked.

Liam (Payroll): Pre-note can stay "pending" in the preview until the bank verification completes. If you updated on 07/11 it should clear by 07/16. If it still shows old bank on 07/17 DM me with the last 4 digits.

Olivia Park: Last 4 are 7890, DMing now.

Sanya (Benefits): Back to dental waiver — I sent the waiver request to the carrier and flagged it as a new-employee request. If the carrier approves, I'll update enrollment and let Payroll know for retro premium refunds if needed.

Olivia Park: One last small thing — my W-4 preview still shows single + 1 allowance though I filed as married in Workday. Will that sync with payroll?

Liam (Payroll): Workday updates run into payroll nightly; if you changed before the cutoff it applies to the next run. I see your W-4 effective 07/11 in Workday, so payroll will use that on 07/20. If anything looks off after that, DM me.

Olivia Park: Great, thank you all so much! :heart:

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: Sanya requested dental waiver (waiting on carrier 3-7 business days); Liam queued relocation off-cycle for advance (ETA 07/18) and will process R-8890 on 07/20 if advance not needed; direct deposit pre-note pending until 07/16; W-4 effective 07/20. Ping benefits@redwood.com or payroll@redwood.com for follow-ups.
